findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range' (no error message, no retry)
findings.steps: Sign in, make GET /api/stats/harvests return 500 (text/plain body), click 'Stats' in the nav.
findings.expected: An error message such as 'Could not load stats' with a Retry button. Never an empty state.
findings.actual: The page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range. Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.' The error only appears in the console. stats.vue never reads `error` from useApiFetch: the EmptyState v-else branch matches any non-pending status, including 'error'. There is no retry control either; the only way to refetch is to change a date.
findings.evidence: main innerText with the 500 mocked: 'Stats … From To No harvests in this range Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here. Log harvest'. Console: 2 errors.

findings.title: Inverted or partly cleared date range shows 'No harvests' instead of the server's validation message
findings.steps: On /stats set From to 2026-06-01, then type 2020-01-01 into To (typing ignores the min/max attributes). Or clear From and set To to an earlier year: the server then fills in From as 1 Jan of the current year, which is after To.
findings.expected: A visible reason, e.g. 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' (the API already returns this as a 422 detail).
findings.actual: The 422 is ignored and the page shows 'No harvests in this range', which tells the user the range is valid but empty.
findings.evidence: After filling To=2020-01-01 the page read 'No harvests in this range …'. The API returns 422 {"detail":"The From date must be on or before the To date."} for from=2026-01-01&to=2025-01-01 and also for to=2020-01-01 alone.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout; a request that never answers shows 'Loading stats…' forever
findings.steps: Make /api/stats/harvests hang (never respond), then change a date on /stats and wait more than 10 seconds.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s and the page shows an error with a Retry button.
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still showed 'Loading stats…' and nothing else. useApiFetch is called without a timeout.
findings.evidence: main innerText at 13 s: 'Stats … From To This year Loading stats…'
